news.title: A First Look at Polling Performance in 2026
news.summary_en: Preelection polls captured the direction of this year’s election, while generally understating the size of Democrats’ advantage.

news.title: About a Third of Americans Have Left an Online Community
news.summary_en: About a third of U.S. adults have left an online community, most often because they lost interest. Younger adults are likelier to leave.

news.title: Majority of Americans Say Social Media Companies, News Outlets Have Too Much Power in Politics
news.summary_en: About seven-in-ten Americans say social media firms wield too much political power; 55% say so of news outlets, but Republicans and Democrats differ.

news.title: LGBTQ Americans Stand Out for Being Part of Online Communities, Finding Value in Them
news.summary_en: LGBTQ adults are more likely to join online communities, though some also leave over people being harassed.
